comparison_rule: When comparing reasoning families, use decontaminated identical/isomorphic tasks, keep literal style features separate from structural events, and score correctness/verification/recovery/token efficiency independently.
privacy_rule: Opaque or encrypted reasoning fields from public proprietary logs are sensitive quarantine material, not a decryption opportunity.
